nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.expected_fixed_prefix_decomposition
nodes.header:
theorem expected_fixed_prefix_decomposition {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) =
      (T : ℝ) * variance (Y 0) μ +
        (T : ℝ) * (u - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2
nodes.source_class: Derived expected-fixed-prefix decomposition; no independence required.

theorem expected_fixed_prefix_minimum {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))

    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) :

      IsLeast ((fun u : ℝ => ∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (u - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) ''
        Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ((T : ℝ) * variance (Y 0) μ)
nodes.source_class: Actual feasible distribution mean produces image membership and lower comparisons.

    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))

    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) :

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.iid_cumulative_prediction_decomposition
nodes.header:
theorem iid_cumulative_prediction_decomposition {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (prediction : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ t, MemLp (prediction t) 2 μ)
    (hInd : ∀ t, IndepFun (prediction t) (Y t) μ) (T : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (prediction t ω - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) -
      (T : ℝ) * variance (Y 0) μ =
        ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
          ∫ ω, (prediction t ω - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ
nodes.source_class: Intermediate consumer only; two genuine causal producers follow.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.history_policy_expectedFixed_excess
nodes.header:
theorem history_policy_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (policy : (t : ℕ) → ((↑(Finset.range t) : Type) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ t, Measurable (policy t))
    (hpb : ∀ t z, (∀ i, z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      policy t z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => policy t (fun i => Y i ω)) T =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
        ∫ ω, (policy t (fun i => Y i ω) - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧
      0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => policy t (fun i => Y i ω)) T
nodes.source_class: Actual deterministic measurable bounded strict-history policy; current-target independence derived, not supplied.

    (hind : iIndepFun Y μ) (T : ℕ) :
    expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => meanPredict (fun i => Y i ω) t) T =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
        ∫ ω, (meanPredict (fun i => Y i ω) t - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧

nodes.source_class: Distribution-known fixed mean attains benchmark; not an executable learner discovering an unknown mean.

nodes.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.history_policy_normalized_expectedFixed_excess
nodes.header:
theorem history_policy_normalized_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t))
    (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (policy : (t : ℕ) → ((↑(Finset.range t) : Type) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ t, Measurable (policy t))
    (hpb : ∀ t z, (∀ i, z i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      policy t z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ ω, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, (policy t (fun i => Y i ω) - Y t ω)^2 ∂μ) /
        (T : ℝ) - variance (Y 0) μ =
      expectedFixedRegret μ Y (fun t ω => policy t (fun i => Y i ω)) T / (T : ℝ)
nodes.source_class: Source finite-horizon normalization, T>0; asymptotic success equivalence remains separately required.
